allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Dragon Hunters is a fantastic tale telling the adventures of two dragon hunters: the world has become a vast conglomerate of islands of varying size and shape. This babbling universe is mainly peopled with ruthless rogues, surly peasants and illiterate, petty lords Their main concerns revolve around two fundamental rules : Eat and don't get eaten.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: In a fractured sky where survival is never guaranteed, how do two freelance hunters manage to stay atop the food chain?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In a fractured world made of floating islands, two wandering hunters navigate an unruly realm filled with rogues, surly peasants, and petty lords, where survival hinges on one basic rule: eat and don't get eaten.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Exciting, lightweight, and easy to watch, offering an energetic 82-minute animated escape for family viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Co-directors Arthur Qwak and Guillaume Ivernel craft an imaginative animated adventure that delivers brisk, family-friendly fantasy across an inventive floating landscape.
